summary: Iteration 6: Verified new 'Lieux hantés' universe (9 places: 5 France + 4 monde) end-to-end. Backend: 32/32 pytest passing (updated counts to 62 stories / 12 universes; added 6 new tests for lieux-hantes universe count, story list, dossier filters france/monde, dossiers endpoint counts, and lieu-brissac detail with 5 specs). Frontend: /univers/lieux-hantes correctly renders dossier filter row (Tous·9 / En France·5 / Dans le monde·4), lieux-map-section with parchment-map, 9 pins, 9 story cards. Clicking 'En France' reduces grid to 5 cards and parchment map remains visible and re-projects. Hover on parchment-pin-lieu-brissac produces tooltip with title. /recit/lieu-brissac shows AudioPlayer + specs-block containing exactly 5 dt/dd pairs, plus sections/sources/tags. /recit/lieu-glamis renders correctly. Regression: /voyage, /frise, /origine, /livre-du-soir, /univers/morts-etranges all return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: ParchmentMap pins overlap physically in the France region (Brissac/Combourg/Mortemer cluster) — Playwright hover intercepted by neighbouring pin. Real user hover still works, but consider small offset or z-index cycling for accessibility.
ParchmentMap useEffect has empty deps so it fetches only once — good; dossier filter applied via useMemo — good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend catalog now has 62 stories / 12 universes. Lieux-hantes universe has 9 stories with 2 dossiers (france=5, monde=4). Each lieu story has a 'specs' array of 5 label/value pairs and a 'place_type' field. Frontend testids added: lieux-map-section, parchment-map, parchment-pin-{story_id}, specs-block, dossier-filters, dossier-{id}. To test pin hover in Playwright, use JS dispatchEvent('mouseenter') since geographic clusters overlap.
